wire.t: Week 10 waivers ran overnight. JAY2913 paid $13 for Xavier Hutchinson and dropped Efton Chism III. Bill_Buttlicker paid $11 for Tampa Bay rookie quarterback Jalon Daniels and dropped Marquise Brown. Br0phy paid $1 for Emari Demercado and dropped Najee Harris.
jrsmith1391 added Myles Price to Catfan94’s Farm Team Wednesday morning and dropped Zonovan Knight, who started at flex in Week 10 and scored 2.4.

Baker Mayfield's status for Sunday against Detroit is uncertain with a foot and ankle injury from Week 9, per NFL Network's Mike Garafolo. Injured reserve isn't in play. Jalon Daniels started three games in Mayfield's place earlier this season and went 1-2. Mayfield is on Catfan94’s Farm Team; Daniels is now on StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte.

Geno Smith had an MRI on his left ankle Monday and Aaron Glenn said an update would come later in the week; if healthy, Smith stays the starter against the Chargers. Cade Klubnik is next up. Sleeper now lists Smith as Questionable, which matters for OBJAY.

Brock Bowers is viewed as day-to-day with the ankle and isn't believed to have a major injury, per Ian Rapoport, though his practice participation is expected to be limited before Denver. Sleeper has moved him from Out to Questionable for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix.

Drake Maye needs more tests on his ankle, and reports say the Patriots feared a fracture. New England is on bye in Week 11. Maye is Out on Sleeper, which is why StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte was shopping for quarterbacks at 3 AM.

Sleeper status upgrades this week: Mike Evans, Marvin Harrison Jr. and Jaylen Waddle went from Out to Questionable for Jefferson’s Reserve, DeVonta Smith and T.J. Hockenson are Questionable for Catfan94’s Farm Team, and Ladd McConkey is Questionable for Asian Jim.

Six teams are on bye in Week 11: Atlanta, Cleveland, Green Bay, the Rams, New England and Seattle. That takes out Michael Penix Jr. and Jordan Love for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix, Deshaun Watson for Catfan94’s Farm Team and Jaxon Smith-Njigba for Asian Jim.

stories.title: I paid $11 for a quarterback who only plays if somebody else's quarterback can't
stories.dek: Jalon Daniels is mine, Marquise Brown is gone, and Baker Mayfield's ankle now decides whether StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte has a quarterback on Sunday.
body: Here's where I was Tuesday: Drake Maye Out and on bye, Jalen Hurts on IR, Shedeur Sanders on my taxi squad with Cleveland on bye, and Justin Fields as the only healthy quarterback, sitting behind Patrick Mahomes in Kansas City. So I put in $11 on Jalon Daniels, the Tampa Bay rookie, and dropped Marquise Brown, who isn't on an NFL team. That drop I'll defend. The bid is the part you can laugh at.

Daniels starts only if Baker Mayfield can't. Mike Garafolo says Mayfield's foot and ankle make him uncertain for Detroit, but it's not an IR thing. Daniels started three games earlier this year and went 1-2. So my Week 11 superflex plan is rooting against a quarterback on Catfan94’s Farm Team, which is also the third-best team in the league. jrsmith1391, nothing personal. I'm just broke at the position.

JAY2913 won the night with $13 on Xavier Hutchinson, dropping Efton Chism III, who's on bye with New England anyway. Br0phy spent $1 on Emari Demercado and dropped Najee Harris, who also isn't on an NFL team, so Dude, Your Getting a Dell made a correct roster move in Week 11, and I want that on the record. Then this morning jrsmith1391 grabbed Myles Price and cut Zonovan Knight, the 2.4-point flex from Week 10.

FAAB check: I've spent $17 of $100 and still have 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts, so I'm rich in every currency except points. TheMoneyTeam2302 has spent $87 and is 9‑1. Catfan94 has spent $81 and is 9‑1. jmello16 has spent $0, is 5‑5, and is probably the smartest guy in the room. The line didn't move much for me: I'm now a 45.0-point underdog to The Champ instead of 48.5. That's $11 for 3.5 points. Bargain.

stories.title: Week 10: Hold My DK beats me by 117.42, Asian Jim steals Monday night, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑10
stories.dek: Two teams are 9‑1, four teams are fighting over three playoff spots, and I'm 3‑7 with no quarterback for Week 11.
body: Hold My DK 196.34, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 78.92. That's a 117.42-point margin, the biggest of the week and the second-biggest of the season behind Catfan94's 127.22 in Week 5. Christian McCaffrey had 50.3, Patrick Mahomes 45.92, and Derrick Henry added 16.5 on Monday night with two touchdowns on 10 yards rushing. Chuba Hubbard scored 35.7 on the bench. TheMoneyTeam2302 is 9‑1 and has scored 1582.92 points.

The game of the week happened Monday. Kraft for Cash led Asian Jim 89.30 to 84.06 going into Chargers at Ravens, and BTaylor1 had Zay Flowers left against three for ManicOrientals. Flowers scored 9.9. Omarion Hampton ran for 105 yards and a touchdown for 19.0, Tre' Harris caught five for 86 (12.6) and Justice Hill added 7.8. Final: Asian Jim 123.46, Kraft for Cash 99.20. ManicOrientals pulled Ladd McConkey for Harris before kickoff, and that move is worth a win. Asian Jim has won three straight and is 5‑5.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat Jefferson’s Reserve 232.54 to 134.62, the second-highest score in league history, and is 9‑1 with six straight wins. The Champ beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 166.08 to 68.10; Jacoby Brissett threw for 340 yards and scored 12.3, and Br0phy is 0‑10. Catfan94’s Farm Team beat OBJAY 138.94 to 83.62, and I Chase Brown Kids beat Bourbon Lover 124.46 to 116.92 in the closest game of the week.

Bad beat: Jefferson’s Reserve scored 134.62, the fifth-highest score of the week, and lost by 97.92. Low score: Dude, Your Getting a Dell at 68.10. And for the record, I scored 78.92 and started AJ Barner at superflex while Dalton Schultz (8.1) and Samaje Perine (13.9) sat on my bench. Swap those two in and I score 93.12 and lose by 103.22 instead of 117.42. Still the worst week of anyone not named Br0phy.

stories.title: Brock Bowers, Geno Smith and a pile of Sleeper upgrades: who's actually playing in Week 11
stories.dek: Half the 'Out' tags from Tuesday are 'Questionable' tags on Wednesday. Here's what that does to the lines.
body: Brock Bowers went from Out to Questionable on Sleeper. Ian Rapoport says the ankle isn't a major injury and he's day-to-day, though practice will be limited before Denver. That's the reason LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix moved from a 36.2-point favorite to 38.5 over I Chase Brown Kids. Catfan94 still has Josh Allen as the only active quarterback with Michael Penix Jr. and Jordan Love on bye.

Geno Smith had an MRI on his ankle Monday, and Aaron Glenn says he's still the starter if he's healthy. Sleeper lists him Questionable. If he plays, OBJAY has a real second quarterback next to Bo Nix instead of Kyle McCord, so Kraft for Cash drops from a 19.0-point favorite to 17.0. Woody Marks is Doubtful and Jaxson Dart is still on IR.

Jefferson’s Reserve got the best news of anybody: Mike Evans, Marvin Harrison Jr. and Jaylen Waddle all went from Out to Questionable. jmello16 is a 22.3-point favorite over Bourbon Lover and has Trevor Lawrence and C.J. Stroud at quarterback. Catfan94’s Farm Team has DeVonta Smith and T.J. Hockenson Questionable, Kenneth Walker III Questionable after Rapoport said he's expected back, and Baker Mayfield uncertain.

Asian Jim gets Ladd McConkey back to Questionable, but Kyler Murray is still Out and Jaxon Smith-Njigba is on bye, so ManicOrientals is down to Daniel Jones and Tyler Shough at quarterback. Drake Maye is still Out for me, and New England is on bye regardless. These tags will move again Thursday and Friday. Check before you set a lineup, and don't be me.

stories.title: Four weeks left: Kraft for Cash is 6‑4, and The Champ, Jefferson’s Reserve and Asian Jim are all 5‑5
stories.dek: Six teams make it. The top three are close to locked. The tiebreaker is points for, and TJohn91 has the most of the 5‑5 teams by a lot.
body: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK are 9‑1. Catfan94’s Farm Team is 7‑3. Those three are at least two games clear of seventh place with four weeks to play, so the real fight is for spots four through six between Kraft for Cash at 6‑4 and three teams at 5‑5.

Points for is the tiebreaker. Among the 5‑5 teams: The Champ 1414.72, Jefferson’s Reserve 1253.50, Asian Jim 1191.98. TJohn91 is 161.22 points ahead of jmello16 and 222.74 ahead of ManicOrientals, which is almost two full weeks of scoring. If it's a three-way tie at the end, the two-time champ is in.

I Chase Brown Kids (1219.86) and OBJAY (1184.34) are 4‑6, one game back. Bourbon Lover and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte are 3‑7 and need four straight wins and some help. Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑10 and mathematically eliminated: seven teams already have five wins, and Br0phy can finish with four at best.

This week's games that matter: Jefferson’s Reserve is a 22.3-point favorite over Bourbon Lover. Kraft for Cash is a 17.0-point favorite over OBJAY now that Geno Smith is Questionable. Catfan94’s Farm Team is a 27.7-point favorite over Asian Jim, with Smith-Njigba on bye. And The Champ gets me, a team whose quarterback depends on Baker Mayfield's ankle, so pencil TJohn91 in for 6‑5.

columns.title: Bill_Buttlicker didn't fix his quarterback problem. He bought a raffle ticket.
columns.dek: Richard "Dick" Gozinya has seen lottery tickets with better odds than an $11 backup who needs someone else's ankle to cooperate.
body: I'll give the man this: dropping Marquise Brown was right. Brown isn't on an NFL team. You can't play a guy who doesn't have a locker. That's the one thing in this transaction I'd sign off on.

Everything else is hope dressed up as strategy. Jalon Daniels starts for Tampa Bay only if Baker Mayfield's foot and ankle keep him out against Detroit. Daniels went 1-2 in three starts earlier this year. Bill_Buttlicker is 3‑7, a 45.0-point underdog, and his quarterback plan depends on another manager's quarterback getting worse. When I played, we didn't pray for the other guy to pull a hamstring. We hit him until he did. Fantasy-wise, I mean.

Meanwhile, Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts and has 28 losses all time. That's the real move. Stop paying $11 for Sunday and start packaging picks for a quarterback who'll be in the lineup in 2027. You're not contending. Act like it. Toughen up.

columns.title: 6 bye-week tips from Holden McGroin, who once started a punter on bye and called it 'resting him'
columns.dek: Six NFL teams are off this week. Holden McGroin has a plan for all of them, and every plan is wrong.
body: 1. Start your bye-week players anyway. They're rested. Fresh legs score more points, and zero is technically a number, which means it's technically a score.

2. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix has Michael Penix Jr. and Jordan Love on bye. Catfan94 should bench Josh Allen too, for team chemistry. Nobody likes the one guy who shows up when everybody else stayed home.

3. Bill_Buttlicker's only available quarterback is Justin Fields, Kansas City's backup. My advice: start Fields at quarterback and Shedeur Sanders at superflex. I'm told Shedeur is on the taxi squad and Cleveland is on bye. That's two reasons he'll be well-rested.
4. Hold My DK is a 77.0-point favorite. Br0phy should try to make it close by trading away everyone who scored last week. Fewer players means fewer bad decisions. That's addition.
5. Kenneth Walker III is expected back for Kansas City, so drop Emmett Johnson immediately. He only scored 34.6 last week. Players who score 34.6 are due to score less, and I'd rather get out early.
6. When in doubt, start the guy with the coolest name. That's how I finished 14th in a 12-team league, and nobody's ever been able to explain it.

columns.title: Hold My DK spent $87 of FAAB and has 87 all-play wins. My spreadsheet calls this proof.
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot ran the waiver numbers and found a correlation that is absolutely not a coincidence, according to her.
body: League-wide, managers have spent $445 of $1,200 in FAAB this year. TheMoneyTeam2302 has spent $87 and Hold My DK's all-play record is 87-23. That's a 1.00 FAAB-to-all-play-win ratio, the purest number in this league. I've named it the Money Constant.

Catfan94 has spent $81 and has 95 all-play wins, a ratio of 1.17, meaning every FAAB dollar is worth 1.17 wins. TJohn91 spent $80 and has 68, so each dollar of The Champ's is worth 0.85 wins. My conclusion: TJohn91 has been overpaying by 15%, and as a two-time champion he should know better.

Then there's jmello16, who has spent $0 and has 54 all-play wins. That's an infinite ratio. My spreadsheet returned #DIV/0!, which I'm treating as 'the best value in league history.' Br0phy spent $11 total and has 5 all-play wins, 0.45 per dollar. Bill_Buttlicker has spent $17 for 28, which is 1.65 per dollar, better than Catfan94's 1.17. He asked me to put that in bold. I did not, because he's 3‑7.

Scored 15.7 on the Asian Jim bench while Austin Ekeler (9.2) and Justice Hill (7.8) started. Asian Jim won anyway, which McGowan considers beside the point.
Scored 9.4 on the Bourbon Lover bench while Demarcus Robinson (0.0) and Keon Coleman (2.1) started. Bourbon Lover lost by 7.54. Jeudy has done the math.

Scored 14.2 on the Catfan94’s Farm Team taxi squad in Week 10 while Zonovan Knight started at flex and scored 2.4. jrsmith1391 has since cut Knight and picked up Myles Price instead of promoting Cameron. Cameron noticed.
Scored 12.4 on the Jefferson’s Reserve taxi squad while Chris Olave started and scored 6.0. Jefferson’s Reserve lost by 97.92, so it didn't matter, but he'd still like to be asked.
